tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save important information to long-term memory. Always set collection when the topic is clear: project work → project:<slug>, personal tastes → personal:preferences. Use append_to to extend an existing memory instead of creating duplicates.

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional tags. A tag like project:my-app also sets collection automatically.

params.name: type
params.description: Category for this memory. Default: general. Use preference for tastes, fact for stable truths, instruction for rules.

params.name: content
params.description: The information to remember.

params.name: append_to
params.description: UUID of an existing memory to append to (same user). Keeps revision history.

params.name: collection
params.description: Scope slug for this memory (e.g. project:henry-memory, personal:preferences, work:client-x). Use the same collection in recall/get_context when the user asks about that topic.

params.name: importance
params.description: Relevance weight from 0 (low) to 1 (high) for ranking in recall. Default: 0.5.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search long-term memory. Pass collection (and/or tags, type) to search only that scope — e.g. collection=project:henry-memory for project questions, collection=personal:preferences for tastes.

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional tags. A tag like project:my-app also sets collection automatically.

params.name: type
params.description: Memory category: general, preference, fact, instruction, or conversation. Omit to include all types.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results. Omit for server default (10). Capped per your plan on the server.

params.name: query
params.description: Natural-language search query (e.g. "Henry project stack", "user prefers dark mode").

params.name: collection
params.description: Scope slug for this memory (e.g. project:henry-memory, personal:preferences, work:client-x). Use the same collection in recall/get_context when the user asks about that topic.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Build a formatted context block for the current topic. Use collection to limit results to one domain (project, preferences, etc.).

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional tags. A tag like project:my-app also sets collection automatically.

params.name: type
params.description: Memory category: general, preference, fact, instruction, or conversation. Omit to include all types.

params.name: topic
params.description: Subject to build context for (e.g. "current project", "client meeting notes").

params.name: collection
params.description: Scope slug for this memory (e.g. project:henry-memory, personal:preferences, work:client-x). Use the same collection in recall/get_context when the user asks about that topic.

params.name: max_memories
params.description: Max memories in context block. Omit for server default (10). Capped per your plan.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List recent memories. Filter by collection, tags, or type to browse one group.

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional tags. A tag like project:my-app also sets collection automatically.

params.name: type
params.description: Memory category: general, preference, fact, instruction, or conversation. Omit to include all types.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many memories to return. Omit for server default (20). Capped per your plan.

params.name: collection
params.description: Scope slug for this memory (e.g. project:henry-memory, personal:preferences, work:client-x). Use the same collection in recall/get_context when the user asks about that topic.

params.name: full_content
params.description: When true, return full memory text instead of a 120-character preview.

tools.name: get_memory
tools.description: Get the full content of a single memory by its UUID (from list_memories or recall).

params.name: memory_id
params.description: UUID of the memory to retrieve.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List memory collections (folders/scopes) for this user. Use slugs in remember/recall/get_context.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a specific memory by ID.

params.name: memory_id
params.description: UUID of the memory to delete (from list_memories or recall).

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Show statistics about stored memories (by type and collection).

resources.name: Recent Memories
resources.description: Your most recent memories (count capped per plan)
